text:
This is terrible. My mother had dental problems (due to a condition that occurred a year ago). Initially, they said they would take responsibility by extracting the problematic tooth and replacing it with a new denture. They called around early April and scheduled an appointment for May 2nd. However, upon arrival, they said it couldn't be done; everything would need to be redone, and there would be additional costs.

The management is awful. My mother wasted a lot of time waiting to see the doctor, only for the doctor to explain why the clinic's proposed solution wasn't feasible.

Then, today, May 8th, they called to inform us of the costs involved if the procedure was to proceed. They also claimed they were unaware of the initial offer. How could the patient know and wait if they weren't aware? (Or do they think the patient is lying?) They even said the clinic didn't inform her.

I understand there's a change of ownership, but if they treat customers with such dishonesty, I won't trust them with my dental care anymore.

Their management is appalling. All they say is "waiting to consult with the partner doctor," or "waiting for the doctor to give birth before they can proceed." Shouldn't there be a better solution for this? I hope this improves.

restaurant_name: คลินิกศูนย์ทันตกรรมบ้านฟันดี
text: The dentist took only 30 minutes to extract one tooth and fill two front fillings. She was kind, spoke well, and there was minimal bleeding. Her name is Dr. Wannaporn (it's a bit of a long name!), but I really like her skills. I've had four teeth extracted here and I really like Baan Fun Dee (a dental clinic).

restaurant_name: คลินิกศูนย์ทันตกรรมบ้านฟันดี
text: The doctor's assistant in room 1 had a terrible attitude. She was grumpy and didn't smile at all. Other clinics have similar assistants; it's not just yours. I'm telling you, this is the last time I'll ever go there. I paid for this service; I wasn't asking for it for free. It was awful.
